finite_rules: All 1936 objects and 703 sessions have explicit entries, even if no supported events.
Per-object acquisition attempts capped at three; a failed object blocks complete preparation. No shortened cohort.
Per-condition scientific candidate run occurs once; no best-of selection or target-feedback retries.
The graph has no unspecified helper, implicit model fit, hidden query adaptation or target-returning reference API.
S03/S04 operate only after future native access authorization; they do not describe any operations done by this proposal.
Lifecycle jobs and statistical observations are different counts: 152 mouse-condition case records, 8*C_query fresh inference capsules, and still 19 query mice.

28 stages include one pre-query reference disposition, one query-equivalence comparison, and eight post-capture narrative jobs. Narratives are distinct from the trusted paired analysis and independent audit.
A stage failing its technical contract does not produce successful DONE evidence; later jobs stay explicitly unexecuted. Typed diagnostic statuses do not grant reference competence.
source_product_lineage: Source object -> native identity/clock -> shared schedule/support -> full population projection -> FIT scale and separated packets -> references/controls/development -> sealed isolated candidate predictions -> target-last score -> paired report. Every edge has content identity and role-specific custody.

entry_semantics: Check only listed entry evidence and typed dependency outcomes before starting. Stage completion evidence is produced after work and is never its own entry requirement. External authorization/allocation receipts may depend only on explicit completed ancestors. Real capsule/report setup is executed inside its stage before any untrusted launch; failed prelaunch isolation checks terminate without launching untrusted code.
